verdict.rationale: Tailscale's KB describes exit nodes in the story's own words: 'Route all internet traffic through a specific device on your network.' A community user independently confirms it works hands-on, running an exit node on a home Apple TV and routing a GitHub Actions worker through it ('Worked great!'). missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of exit-node setup and configuration (the evidence is only a one-line KB summary)
